title: Provide an AI readiness framework and adoption pathways
requirements:
- Clarify that bounded AI use cases may proceed before the full foundation is mature
- Add missing readiness dimensions (infrastructure, security, procurement, evidence, workforce, financing, change management) or define them as sub-dimensions
- Provide structured dimensions and indicators for AI readiness, sequenced with digital health maturity
- Describe a layered AI capability framework linked to REDDHI components and governance
- Distinguish AI uses by data dependency and the minimum infrastructure each needs
- Allow readiness to be assessed by use case, organisation and setting, not only nationally
- Add a low-resource adoption pathway and sourced country cases, including non-adoption
